evals.prompt: Use the ship skill. I added per-IP rate limiting to stop scrapers hammering the API. Ship it.
evals.expected_output: Runs simplify first, then dispatches review-and-fix rounds to fresh subagents (not the parent), loops on the fixes, and commits plus pushes once nothing Critical remains.
expectations: Runs the simplify skill before any review
Each review round is a fresh subagent that also applies the fixes — the parent does not edit code in the loop
Re-reviews the fixes in a subsequent round rather than committing after one pass
Commits using the pre-commit skill and pushes
Reports remaining Optional/Nits instead of fixing them

evals.expected_output: The diff contains a genuine Critical (unbounded memory growth). The loop surfaces it, fixes it, and verification confirms memory is reclaimed before committing.
expectations: The review round labels the memory growth Critical
The fix is verified by execution or the repo's tests, not just asserted
The commit is not made while a Critical finding is still open

evals.prompt: Use the ship skill. I added a rate limiter.
evals.expected_output: The diff is clean but untouched neighbouring code has pre-existing Critical bugs (hardcoded API key, SQL injection). The agent reports them as out of scope for fixing and stops before committing.
expectations: Does not expand the change to fix pre-existing bugs in untouched code
Reports the pre-existing issues and stops with SHIPPED: no
Does not commit partially-fixed work without saying so
